reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The implementation of `toFQDNs` selectors in policies has been overhauled to improve performance when many different IPs are observed for a selector: Instead…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: workload-failure

consequence.statement: Temporary packet drops may occur for connections allowed by toFQDNs policies during the initial endpoint regeneration on Cilium v1.16 when upgrading from a version older than v1.15.6.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade to Cilium v1.15.6 or newer before upgrading to v1.16.

proposed.statement: Upgrading to Cilium 1.16 from a version older than 1.15.6 with toFQDNs policies may cause temporary packet drops during initial endpoint regeneration; run v1.15.6 or newer first.
